facts.fact: Lily 第一次玩双人拖伞，开局不顺，吓得尖叫喊“我们要死了”。
facts.anchor: It was her first time tandem parasailing, and it wasn’t going well.

facts.fact: 表姐 Jordan 胆大敢飞四百英尺高空，Lily 则是求稳、只想活到十四岁的女孩。
facts.anchor: She always did insane stuff like fly four hundred feet above the ocean tied to a piece of nylon.

facts.fact: Sam 是 Lily 的双胞胎兄弟，此刻正独自拖伞飞在她们几英尺外。
facts.anchor: Sam was Lily’s twin brother. He was flying solo just a few feet away from them, grinning widely

facts.fact: 导游介绍：钻石形的天堂岛上有运河，Bliss Bridge 是主通道，东侧 Tranquil Cove 是成人别墅区，西侧 Thrill Harbor 专留给十八岁以下客人。
facts.anchor: Bliss Bridge is the major pathway over the canal that winds through our entire diamond-shaped island.

facts.fact: 这次全部免费的度假是祖母 Penelope 送的圣诞惊喜礼物，Lily 几乎没见过她。
facts.anchor: This all-expenses-paid vacation was a surprise Christmas gift from their grandmother, Penelope.

facts.fact: 上岸后 Lily 蹑手蹑脚弹了 Sam 右耳上方几厘米的头部侧面，报复他激自己去拖伞。
facts.anchor: She leaned over, zeroed in, and flicked Sam in the side of the head, a few centimeters above his right ear.

facts.fact: 海滩闲聊时 Jordan 崩溃透露全家要搬去加拿大温哥华，一回到家就动身。
facts.anchor: “No, I’m not okay,” Jordan snapped. “We’re moving. To Vancouver, of all places.”

facts.fact: 章末三人吐沫握手，正式立下“把这次度假过成有史以来最好一次”的约定。
facts.anchor: But he shook, and the pact was officially sealed. Then they all wiped their hands off with the beach towels
